title: Motion-Picture Film (65-mm) - Camera Aperture Image and Usage, 15/70 Format
scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions of the camera aperture image and the relative positions of the vertical and horizontal centerlines of the intended image area with respect to the reference edge and the perforations of the camera negative film for 65-mm 15/70 motion-picture cameras. 1.2 This standard also specifies the position of the emulsion and the normal frame rate.
